problem_restatement: Determine whether the first live v52 hour contains a technical routing defect, a repeatable missed entry, or valid ineligible conditions under the frozen BTC and HYPE routes, without consuming market data that predates signal availability.

correction.defect: The v1 diagnostic started forward paths at decision_time_ms even when the provider evaluation was published later in that minute.
correction.failure_mode: Pre-availability high, low, or close observations could inflate or depress MFE, MAE, and close-return evidence used to judge live strategy gates.
correction.subminute_limitation: Exact post-publication subminute path would require a separately frozen trade or quote tape; no partial candle is synthesized.

system_reconciliation.assessment: Every configured route produced readiness telemetry and reconciled to an explicit ineligible state. No missing action, technical rejection, stale submission, unexplained order, fill, or position was observed.

route_evidence.diagnosis: The route correctly remained inactive: expansion, usable ADX, score, and entry side were absent. Three readiness rows and no one-blocker near miss cannot diagnose over-gating.
Volume passed, but price did not sweep below the prior low and the reclaim closed below EMA55. The causal hourly decision was correctly ineligible.

No fresh completed-5m breakout onset occurred. One of 13 independent missing-onset 5m paths cleared the fixed friction hurdle, but the independent mean and largest-winner-removed mean remained substantially negative and robust MFE evidence remained zero.

only_one_blocker_near_miss.interpretation: The single path cleared estimated cost only at 30 minutes, failed at 5 and 15 minutes, and never reached the predeclared robust-MFE threshold. It does not justify weakening side alignment.

v1_to_v2_delta.interpretation: The direction and magnitude changed enough to invalidate v1 as decision evidence. The corrected evidence is separately interpreted rather than treated as a cosmetic restatement.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The bounded window is approximately 67 minutes and has no eligible signal or trade.
Markouts are counterfactual completed-candle paths after a fixed friction hurdle, not executable fill replays.
The conservative availability rule excludes the partial publication minute; exact post-publication subminute behavior remains unmeasured.
Overlapping annotations are dependent, so non-overlapping counts and largest-winner sensitivity carry more weight.
No short structural direction occurred, leaving configured HYPE-short execution evidence unresolved.
One cost-clearing observation out of 13 independent 5m paths is compatible with noise and does not establish edge.

decision.reason: The corrected causal evidence contains one small 5m winner but negative independent means at 5m, 15m, and 30m, negative largest-winner sensitivity, no robust MFE, and no eligible lifecycle. There is no repeatable missed edge or technical routing loss in this window.
decision.do_nothing_comparison: Retaining the frozen gates avoided a population whose corrected independent mean remained below estimated friction. Relaxing thresholds from one favorable observation would be post-window selection.
decision.confidence: high that no technical action was lost; high that v1 was causally invalid; medium that retaining the HYPE gates was correct in this short window; low on future profitability until compatible lifecycles close
falsifiers: An eligible decision without action, withholding, conflict, occupancy, staleness, or technical-failure attribution.
Repeated independent same-blocker and same-side paths clearing realistic costs with positive largest-winner-removed results.
A source, side, regime, timing, stop, target, opposite-signal, or maximum-hold mismatch between telemetry and runtime behavior.
Live execution costs or stop behavior materially exceeding the frozen modeled contract.

minimum_evidence_before_reconsidering_pa: The first fully resolved exact-v52 HYPE lifecycle on each configured side, including fees, slippage, funding, MFE, MAE, stop, opposite-signal, and timer attribution.
Or at least 20 non-overlapping same-blocker and same-side near-miss paths under the predeclared availability, friction, and horizon contract.
Any technical inconsistency overrides sample thresholds and is investigated immediately.

highest_value_next_investigation.reason: The first compatible eligible lifecycle will test entry translation, venue friction, protective stop, opposite-signal handling, and maximum-hold behavior; the HYPE short side still has no compatible live evidence.
